assertions.name: tr_M_wenzl_finite_nonzero
assertions.source: Boolean check: math.isfinite(trM_wenzl) AND |trM| > 1e-12 — guards against silent NaN/Inf or zero returns from the common-infra evaluator. Robust against the 'tolerance wider than |computed − expected|' vacuous-pass pitfall.

description: Phase B-4 c_αα probe (EXPLORATORY — NEGATIVE result). Tests whether the substrate-canonical Markov-trace value m_e·|tr_M(T_w(7²_1), q_0)| could replace the literature c_αα = m_e·Vol(7²_1) ≈ 2.43 MeV in alpha_cluster_recursion.py. Result: bare Markov-trace value is ~22.7× smaller than the literature; the substitution does NOT work. Mirrors the proton-mass case (|tr_M(𝓑₃)| << m_p) — bare |tr_M| is not the substrate-pure binding-scale derivation; VolDensity chain (Vol/ℏ_q² × linking_weight) is. This probe does NOT propose changing alpha_cluster_recursion.py.

parameters.evaluator_precision: mp.mpf at 50 dps (L1 floor) via markov_trace_for_knot mpf default; mpf used throughout c_αα arithmetic
